title: The Get Started checklist stands down while a launch box is up, so a member never sees two lists

source.ref: Vera guided launch system, VLS-11. The launch box (VLS-08) is the running launch's list.

verify.note: The decision (a running launch owns the list; no launch, signed out or the switch off leaves Get Started alone) is pinned by lib/launch/box.test.ts; the probe reads the wiring: both the full Get Started panel and the collapsed rail item return nothing while launchOwnsNextSteps is true. Fails on main, where the helper does not exist.

detail: launchOwnsNextSteps (lib/launch/box.ts) is true when the signed-in member has an active launch and the launch system is on. GetStartedPanel and MicroGetStarted in the right rail check it first. Members without a launch, and every member while LAUNCH_SYSTEM_ENABLED is off, see exactly today's checklist.
